race.comment: THE MINSTREL BOY (5) was beaten some way at his second run but that might have been a forgive on the Synthetic. At least there he showed more speed so from the inside draw that might come in handy. Suspect he wants the mile on breeding too. AMSTERDAM NIGHTS (10) gelding by Almanzor out of Gravitelle having first start. Primed for this with two hit-outs, the latest when fourth in a Cranbourne jump-out. In the mix. I'MFALLINFORYOU (7) has yet to salute in 15 career starts, the latest effort a seventh over 2000m at Ballarat. Can contest for a place here. SHUWAIB (4) is a first starter for the A & J Williams stable. Unplaced in recent trials so keep an eye on the betting.
